title: Paradoc's Seat Cushions
body:
This data pack adds seat cushions to Minecraft!
There are 16 colors of cusions, all based on llama carpet patterns.

You can craft each cushion with one carpet of the desired color above one leather.
Punch to break the cushion and Use to get on the cushion.
Only one player per cushion!

Mojang has said that they do not wish to add seating because they feel like it will decrease player creativity. This is why I decided to make only cushions - this way, players are still inspired to create their own chair designs - the cushions simply make them functional!
